plan: This is a first-price sealed-bid auction with 3 bidders and payment at the second-highest bid. This is effectively a Vickrey auction. In a Vickrey auction, the dominant strategy is to bid your true value. Bidding below my value risks losing a profitable opportunity, and bidding above my value risks winning but paying more than the item is worth to me. Since this is the first round and there's no history, I'll stick to the dominant strategy.

I will bid slightly above my value to maximize profit in this single round. Since I don't have historical data, I'll assume other bidders are rational and might bid close to their values. Bidding slightly above my value ensures I win if others bid their true value or less, while minimizing the risk of overpaying significantly.

I will bid slightly above my value to maximize profit, as this is a single-round game and I want to secure the win if possible. Since I pay the second-highest bid, bidding my exact value is a good baseline, but a slight increment increases my chances of winning without significantly impacting profit if I win. I'll aim for a small profit margin.
